description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kobolds of Kher Keep.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Kobolds of Kher Keep dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand.
Repeat.
